# `cable.create`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/cable.create.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`cable.create`: a cable device with its conductors (doc 03 §12).

Creates `Device {tag: {letter, counter}, parts, function_text, structure, cable}` (no function) and one
`Conductor {cable, core, colour, csa, shield, pair}` per spec, in order. Rejected: two specs with the
same core. Outcome: the cable device.

## Types

### Cable

The `Cable` aspect (doc 03 §12).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `core_id_mode` | [`CoreIdMode`](#coreidmode) or `null` | no |  | How cores are identified (FR-CBL-006). |
| `length` | [`LengthSource`](#lengthsource) | no |  | Where the length comes from; default missing (EW-CORE-033). |
| `pre_assembled` | boolean | no |  | Pre-assembled cable (FR-CBL-013). |

### CmdIdent

An identifier: non-empty, one line, NFC, without leading or trailing white space (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### CmdMlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags in ascending order with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### ConductorSpec

One conductor of `cable.create` and `conductor.add`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `colour` | [`ColourSpec`](#colourspec) or `null` | no |  | Core colour. |
| `core` | [`CmdIdent`](#cmdident) | yes |  | Core identification ("1", "BK", "A"). |
| `csa` | [`Csa`](#csa) or `null` | no |  | Core cross-section. |
| `pair` | integer (format `uint8`, min 0, max 255) or `null` | no |  | Twisted pair number. |
| `shield` | boolean | no | `false` | A shield rather than a core. |

### ColourSpec

One or two colour codes (doc 03 §3.4).

Type: array of [`ColourCode`](#colourcode) (at least 1 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### ColourCode

An IEC 60757 or profile-declared company colour code, or {"foreign": code} (doc 05 §3.2).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: [`Ident`](#ident)

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: object { `foreign`: [`Ident`](#ident) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `foreign` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text. |

### CoreIdMode

How the cores of a cable are identified.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"number"` | By number. |
| `"colour"` | By colour. |
| `"both"` | By number and colour. |

### Csa

A cross-section: a Dec3 string in mm², {"awg": n} or {"kcmil": Dec3} (doc 08 §4.6).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: [`Dec3`](#dec3)

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: object { `awg`: integer (min -128, max 127) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `awg` | integer (min -128, max 127) | yes |  |  |

3. **Form 3**

   Shape: object { `kcmil`: [`Dec3`](#dec3) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `kcmil` | [`Dec3`](#dec3) | yes |  | A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader. |

### Dec3

A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader.

Type: string (at most 21 character(s))

Pattern: `^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]{0,15}(?:\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])?|-?0\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])$`

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### LengthSource

The source of a cable length (FR-CBL-009). The committed sources `Estimated` and `Routed` (1.0) are
additive variants of a later format.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: No length yet (the default); blocks release.

   Shape: `"missing"`

2. **Form 2**: Entered by hand.

   Shape: object { `manual`: [`Nm`](#nm) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `manual` | [`Nm`](#nm) | yes |  | A length in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2). Written without fraction or exponent; JSON Schema cannot tell 5 from 5.0, the reader rejects the latter. |

3. **Form 3**: From the cable part (pre-assembled length).

   Shape: `"from_part"`

### Nm

A length in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2). Written without fraction or exponent; JSON Schema cannot tell 5 from 5.0, the reader rejects the latter.

Type: integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)

A part on a device (doc 03 §7): the embedded copy and an optional part variant (FR-PRT-003).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `copy` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The copy ID of the embedded part, `v5(NS_LIBCOPY, library ‖ item)`. |

### StructureAssignment

Which structure node a page, device or structure box belongs to, one slot per aspect (doc 03 §5).
Members follow the canonical aspect order of `ew_rds::Aspect`; the product aspect is the device tree and
has no slot.

```
use ew_schema::StructureAssignment;

let s: StructureAssignment = serde_json::from_str(
    r#"{"function":"7d2c95e0-1f4a-5b38-a6e7-0c93b5d1f284","location":"none"}"#,
).unwrap();
assert!(s.installation_site.is_none()); // absent: inherit
```

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `document_kind` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `&` (pages only). |
| `function` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `=` |
| `functional_assignment` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `==` |
| `installation_site` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `++` |
| `location` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `+` |
| `type` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `%` |
| `user_defined` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `#` |

### Slot

A structure slot: a structure node ID or "none"; absent means inherit (doc 05 §3.2).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: [`Uuid`](#uuid)

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: `"none"`

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); the lines before it stay committed. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
